settings.playback.legacy_controls.description: Playback setting title. Optional legacy remote behavior and previous/next controls.

settings.playback.legacy_controls.copy.value: Seek immediately with Left or Right while the controls are hidden. With controls visible, confirm seeking with OK. Previous restarts after five seconds; otherwise it plays the previous item.
